name: Thomas Sorber
report:
No NBA stats and no projections in our data.

| Price in USD | Yahoo value | Yahoo average cost | Yahoo rank | ESPN value | ESPN average cost | ESPN rank | Our league 2025-26 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-27 | 0 | - | 654 | - | - | - | not drafted |

**Current**
- He is coming back from a torn ACL and has not played yet. Yahoo lists him as questionable with a knee injury. (fact, 2026-10-12; [10-12](https://youtu.be/NhLMyS7Ii5I?t=1897), stats)
- OKC has a crowded big man rotation. Chet Holmgren and Isaiah Hartenstein are the projected starters, and Jaylin Williams and Adimara (Mara) also compete for frontcourt minutes. (fact, 2026-10-12; [10-12](https://youtu.be/NhLMyS7Ii5I?t=220), [10-12](https://youtu.be/NhLMyS7Ii5I?t=1746), [10-12](https://youtu.be/NhLMyS7Ii5I?t=1897))
- With so many centers ahead of him, the expert doubts he will play much this season. (verdict, 2026-10-12; [10-12](https://youtu.be/NhLMyS7Ii5I?t=1897))

**Durable**
- He has a torn ACL and foot surgery on his record, after earlier lower leg injuries at Georgetown. (fact, 2026-07-26; [07-26](https://youtu.be/75Sk_4fkgIM?t=340))
- OKC sees him as more versatile than Mara and able to play both the four and the five. Many draft analysts see him as a five only. (verdict, 2026-07-26; [07-26](https://youtu.be/75Sk_4fkgIM?t=1310))

**Tags**
- Current: `injured now` (Coming back from a torn ACL. Yahoo status Q (Knee).), `minutes competition` (Behind Holmgren and Hartenstein, and competing with Jaylin Williams and Mara for big man minutes.)
- Durable: `injury prone` (Torn ACL and foot surgery after earlier lower leg injuries at Georgetown.)

**Note.** Sorber is not a draft target in our league. Yahoo ranks him 654th with a value of 0 USD, ESPN has no price, and he is far outside the 144 players who get drafted. He is coming back from a torn ACL with a long history of lower leg injuries, and he sits behind Holmgren, Hartenstein, Jaylin Williams and Mara. Early in the season, check only whether he gets cleared and plays real minutes, which would most likely need injuries to OKC's bigs.

<sub>3 notes. Built 2026-10-16 with claude-opus-5-5 high, prompt v3.</sub>
